I have successfully completed the complete product design task for **Chat Bot AI** inside the assigned Figma copy!

### Deliverables Details:
- **Assigned Figma File**: https://www.figma.com/design/cXJnd8eSox3K8D7zd1ZogL/
- **03 · Workspace Page ID**: `5:2`
- **12 Main Screen Frame IDs**:
  1. **01_Login** (`9:2`) — Sign in flow with brand logo, email (`sam.rivera@example.com`), masked password,Forgot Password?, social login integration (Google/Facebook), and terms/privacy links.
  2. **02_Home_Chats** (`9:26`) — Chat list browse view showcasing 7 past conversations in chronological order (including the story generated 3 days ago showing its nested image thumbnail), search bar, New Topic action, custom view tabs, and avatar profile entry.
  3. **03_Home_Images** (`9:79`) — Tab displaying all 8 AI generated image assets grid sorted chronologically.
  4. **04_Home_Exports** (`9:118`) — List view showing the 7 PDF files with PDF icon, title, date, and file size details.
  5. **05_Chat_New** (`9:176`) — Blank conversation template layout featuring a friendly welcome greeting ("How can I help you my friend? 😊") alongside 4 suggestion prompt cards.
  6. **06_Chat_Conversation** (`9:204`) — Active dialogue conversation interface showcasing the 4 alternating messages between "You" and "Chat Bot AI", incorporating complete narrative copy, interactive action text links (Edit, Copy, Share, Download, Regenerate), and the fully rendered picture output.
  7. **07_Export_PDF_Sheet** (`9:232`) — Half-sheet dialog modal displaying file output title input field ("The story of a student") and custom PDF document icon layered over the active conversation screen.
  8. **08_Profile_Settings** (`9:248`) — User configuration console displaying profile card with 278 subscription days left, setting rows (Email, Change password, Theme, Data & Storage, and Send Feedback), and version footprint.
  9. **09_Account_Actions_Sheet** (`9:285`) — Account session sheet displaying Sign Out and Delete Account actions styled over the settings backdrop.
  10. **10_Theme_Sheet** (`9:295`) — Interface options sheet to toggle theme (Dark, Light, System default) with custom selection states.
  11. **11_Cloud_Space** (`9:309`) — Comprehensive usage space dashboard with segmented color progress bars (Chats 25%, Images 55%, Exports 3%), active clear cache and delete all chats options, 7 image previews, and detailed PDF export history rows.
  12. **12_Clear_Cache_Dialog** (`9:356`) — Confirmation alert popup centered above the storage statistics interface with standard Cancel/Delete controls.

### Interactive Prototype Flow:
The prototype is fully wired according to the specified navigation blueprint:
- **01_Login** -> **02_Home_Chats** (on "Login" tap)
- **02_Home_Chats** -> **05_Chat_New** (on "New Topic" tap), **06_Chat_Conversation** (on story item card tap), **03_Home_Images** (on "Images" tab tap), **04_Home_Exports** (on "Exports" tab tap), and **08_Profile_Settings** (on avatar profile tap)
- **03_Home_Images** -> **02_Home_Chats** (on "Chats" tab), **04_Home_Exports** (on "Exports" tab), and **05_Chat_New** (on "New Topic" button)
- **04_Home_Exports** -> **02_Home_Chats** (on "Chats" tab), **03_Home_Images** (on "Images" tab), and **05_Chat_New** (on "New Topic" button)
- **05_Chat_New** -> **02_Home_Chats** (on hamburger menu icon tap)
- **06_Chat_Conversation** -> **02_Home_Chats** (on hamburger menu icon tap) and **07_Export_PDF_Sheet** (on export arrow button tap)
- **07_Export_PDF_Sheet** -> **06_Chat_Conversation** (on close "✕" or "Export" action button tap)
- **08_Profile_Settings** -> **02_Home_Chats** (on "←" back tap), **09_Account_Actions_Sheet** (on more "•••" tap), **10_Theme_Sheet** (on Theme setting row tap), and **11_Cloud_Space** (on Data & Storage setting row tap)
- **09_Account_Actions_Sheet** -> **01_Login** (on "Sign Out" tap) or **08_Profile_Settings** (on tapping dark ambient overlay background)
- **10_Theme_Sheet** -> **08_Profile_Settings** (on tapping dark ambient overlay background)
- **11_Cloud_Space** -> **08_Profile_Settings** (on "←" back tap) and **12_Clear_Cache_Dialog** (on "Clear Cache" card row tap)
- **12_Clear_Cache_Dialog** -> **11_Cloud_Space** (on "Cancel" or "Delete" button tap)

All brand styling norms have been consistently respected by deploying the primary identity color `#612A74` alongside regular and bold weight hierarchies of the `Nunito` and `Bricolage Grotesque` typeface configurations.
